thread:
elaine: Quick sync — planning a lift+stitch bump across api, runtime, console, and sdk. Cutoff is EOD Wed (23:59 PT). Need owners to confirm PRs, changelogs, and branch pins. Tagging folks who own pieces: @tyler @mina @chris

tyler: Ack. API PR is ready but waiting on runtime compat check. :eyes:

mina: Console smoke failing on auth token rotation in staging, looking now. will update in ~15m.

chris: Saw a KV cache eviction regression in runtime tests; re-running perf suite locally.

tyler: If runtime compat check >4h we should consider a targeted patch to avoid blocking the whole bump.

elaine: Agreed — if you need a hotfix branch, use pattern `release/<cut>-hotfix` and run the helper:```./scripts/cherry-pick.sh <commit>```

chris: Good call. Opening a tiny fix PR now: `git checkout -b release/0.14-hotfix && git cherry-pick f3a2c1d`

release-bot: Scheduled release window: Wed 23:00-00:30 PT. Tag PRs with label `release-candidate` to be included.

mina: Added `release-candidate` to console PRs and pushed a changelog draft: https://docs.internal/changelogs/0.14 (note: still needs minor wording)

tyler: API PR merged to main, CI passed, tagged `api@0.14.2`

elaine: Thanks — once everyone is "all green" I'll cut the cut-branch. Please post final status in this thread before I start. If blocked escalate to #eng-oncall.

chris: Patch PR up, CI passing :white_check_mark: merging in 2m.

mina: Console smoke fixed, added an extra test to prevent regression. changelog updated.

elaine: All green from me, starting branch cut in 5m :rocket: 

tyler: Thx — will follow with SDK pin PR after the branch cut.

mina: Leaving a note for support: watch for auth rotation errors during rollout.

elaine: Great coordination — appreciate the quick responses. Will post final artifacts (cut branch name, release notes link) once done.
